item.title: United Airlines Blocks AI Agents from Booking Tickets
item.description:
United Airlines has barred personal AI agents from completing ticket purchases on behalf of travelers, citing privacy, regulatory compliance and reluctance to add another transaction intermediary; agents may still search and display flights. eBay and several major banks have imposed similar limits, signaling enterprise-side friction for agents moving from advice to transaction execution.

原文标题：美联航禁止 AI 助手代订机票

Why it matters：头部航司首次明确划定 AI 智能体可查询不可交易的边界，是代理式 AI 落地受阻的标志性案例。

item.title: Huawei Unveils OSTA Sub-Brand Debuting November 20
item.description:
Huawei's new sub-brand OSTA has released its first teaser video under the slogan 'Come As You Are,' with an official debut set for November 20 at the HarmonyOS Smart Mobility launch event. The first batch is expected to include the O1 and O1 Pro, the latter featuring a Kirin 9-series chip and a 6.39-inch 1.5K flat display, sold through both online and offline channels.

item.title: Amazon Bedrock and Spring AI Enable Autonomous Java Agents
item.description:
AWS introduces Amazon Bedrock AgentCore and integrates it with Spring AI, letting Java teams build autonomous agents that plan, call tools, and retain multi-turn context using familiar Spring idioms. The combination addresses scalability, governance, security, and operational gaps that agent frameworks leave open, with a staged path from prototype to production.

Why it matters：为 Java 企业团队提供了一条基于成熟 JVM 工程体系落地自主智能体的可操作路径。

item.title: Huaqiangbei Brain-Computer Interface Hub Opens with 60% Overseas Visitors
item.description:
A global brain-computer interface application demonstration center has opened on Huaqiangbei pedestrian street in Shenzhen, drawing 600 to 800 visitors daily, over 60% of them overseas tourists and buyers. The venue showcases non-invasive products such as brainwave painting and brainwave-based scent selection, with popular headbands priced at 1,000 to 3,000 yuan, backed by Huaqiangbei's dense supply chain that can deliver PCB prototypes within 12 hours.

原文标题：华强北脑机接口中心开放 六成访客来自海外

item.title: Baidu Releases ERNIE 5.5 Flash Preview with 280B Open Weights
item.description:
Baidu unveiled ERNIE 5.5 Flash Preview, built on a new architecture optimized for efficient inference with 280B total parameters, 14B active per token, a 1M-token context window and over 200 tokens/sec generation. It reached 1668 points on the Code Arena WebDev leaderboard, edging past DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash and Kimi K3 and matching Qwen3.8-Max, with weights to be open-sourced under Apache 2.0 by November 25.

原文标题：百度发布 ERNIE 5.5 Flash 预览版 280B 参数开源

Why it matters：国产开源大模型首次在代码竞技场逼近榜首，且以 Apache 2.0 开放权重，对开源生态与模型选型有直接参考价值。

item.title: Google Ships A2UI 1.0 Letting Agents Render Native UI
item.description:
Google released A2UI 1.0, the first stable version of its open generative-UI protocol, in which agents describe what to display while each app renders it with its own native components, preserving low latency and native fidelity across web, Android, iOS and MCP hosts. The release adds bidirectional function calling and accessibility/metadata extensions, shipping renderers for React, Angular, Lit, Flutter, SwiftUI and Jetpack Compose plus Python, TypeScript and Dart agent SDKs; Atlassian, Bloomberg and ByteDance are already building on it.

原文标题：谷歌发布 A2UI 1.0 稳定版 智能体可直接生成原生 UI

Why it matters：智能体输出形态从纯文本转向原生 UI 的关键协议落地，且已有大厂实际采用，值得关注。

Sam Altman proposed close collaboration with Samsung to build a next-generation AI device positioned as the successor to smartphones, with AI proactively managing users' digital and physical lives. He also argued that AI-assisted work yields only 2-3x productivity gains, while handing entire workflows to AI could deliver up to 100x.

item.title: Google Launches Gemini Decisions API for Fast Multimodal Decision Making
item.description:
Google has launched the Gemini Decisions API, powered by the new Gemini Decision 1 model, which can evaluate up to 1,000 independent yes/no, multiple-choice, and criteria-based questions over multimodal content in a single forward pass with 150-250 ms latency. Targeting tool selection, policy checks, model routing, and context quality assessment, it is priced at $0.10 per million input tokens with free output and is available in Google AI Studio with a free prototyping quota.

原文标题：谷歌发布 Gemini Decisions API 单次前向完成千项决策

Why it matters：谷歌以专用决策模型切入高频低延迟的智能体决策环节，定价与延迟指标对构建 Agent 系统的开发者具有直接参考价值。

item.title: Nvidia Board Hires Outside Firm to Scout Successor to Jensen Huang
item.description:
Nvidia's board has engaged an outside firm to identify candidates to succeed CEO Jensen Huang and is weighing an interim CEO during the search. Board members met on Nov 12 to discuss Huang's future after reports said the board was preparing to remove him. Nvidia shares fell about 8% in after-hours trading, and the company has not responded.

item.title: Claude Model Tier Choice Beats Maxing Out Reasoning Effort
item.description:
Artificial Analysis analyzed Anthropic's current Claude lineup on a cost-per-task basis and found that stepping up a model tier is more cost-effective than maxing out reasoning effort. Claude Opus 5.5 at xhigh scores 57, beating Sonnet 5.5 at max (55) while cutting cost per task by roughly 40% and time per task by about half; Fable 5.2 at high also outperforms Opus 5.5 at max. The pattern breaks at the cheapest tier, where every step up from Haiku 5.5 (max) costs more.

原文标题：Claude 模型层级选择比拉满推理更省钱

Why it matters：为 Claude 用户提供可量化的模型选型与成本权衡依据，具备直接决策参考价值。

Artificial Analysis (@ArtificialAnlys) · llm · signal 58/100

item.title: Tool Use Nearly Doubles Model Scores on Visual Reasoning Benchmark
item.description:
Artificial Analysis reran its VIALS-AA life-sciences visual reasoning benchmark in a one-shot, no-tools format and found tool use nearly doubles scores on average, from about 25% to about 47%. Claude Fable 5.2 leads at 67% with tools but costs $4.20 per task and drops to 44% without them, while Claude Haiku 5.5 reaches 49% with tools at just $0.07 per task, beating the larger model's tool-free result at roughly a tenth of the cost. The takeaway is that cheaper models in an agent harness can outperform single-shot frontier models on both cost and performance.

原文标题：工具调用让模型视觉推理得分近乎翻倍

Why it matters：用对照实验量化了工具调用对视觉推理的增益，并给出成本与效果的权衡数据，对智能体架构选型有直接参考价值。

item.description:
AWS published guidance on running OpenAI Codex inference through Amazon Bedrock using supported models such as GPT-5.6 Sol, while reusing existing IAM identity, regional deployment and observability practices instead of building a second model-access stack. It recommends starting with a small least-privilege pilot and expanding in stages based on evidence.

item.title: Open Source Engine Uses Anti-Unification for Semantic Policy Diffing
item.description:
Textual diffs of formal policies are noisy because semantically equivalent rewrites appear as changes. An open source engine, semi-persistent, computes semantic diffs via anti-unification over an e-graph, deriving the most specific common pattern of two policies and isolating genuine behavioral differences. The approach applies to Cedar, OpenShell and CEL policies, helping reviewers catch critical changes such as an and replaced by an or.

原文标题：开源引擎用反合一实现形式化策略语义差分

Why it matters：为策略即代码场景提供可落地的语义差分方法，并附带开源实现，对安全与合规工程有直接参考价值。

item.title: Amazon HyperPod Adds Silent Data Corruption Detection and Recovery
item.description:
Amazon added three silent data corruption (SDC) checks to the PyTorch DDP training loop on SageMaker HyperPod, detecting anomalies from the job side when hardware reports nothing, then mapping the suspect rank to its node, containing the corruption and recovering. The approach targets large-scale distributed training where wrong-but-plausible numbers silently poison gradients and weights; Meta attributed 6 of 419 unexpected interruptions during Llama 3 405B pre-training to SDC.

原文标题：亚马逊 HyperPod 新增静默数据损坏检测与恢复机制

Why it matters：针对大规模训练中隐蔽且代价高昂的静默数据损坏，给出了可落地的检测与恢复工程方案。

item.title: Google DeepMind Unveils AlphaGenome 2 with Near-Doubled Single-Cell Variant Detection
item.description:
Google DeepMind has released AlphaGenome 2, a next-generation genomic AI model built on a conditional architecture that takes tissue, cell type and cell state as inputs, pushing prediction from tissue-level to single-cell resolution. Trained on over 107 million single-cell profiles, it nearly doubles the ability to detect gene-expression-related variants, identifying 30% of causal disease variants in an immune-cell benchmark versus 16% for its predecessor. It adds DNA methylation prediction and zero-shot generalization to unseen cell types, and is available via API for non-commercial research.

原文标题：谷歌 DeepMind 发布 AlphaGenome 2 单细胞预测能力近乎翻倍

Why it matters：这是 AI for Science 领域的重要节点，单细胞级变异识别能力近乎翻倍，并新增甲基化预测与零样本泛化，对基因组研究与药物发现具有实质价值。

item.title: Chrome Ships Modern Web Guidance 1.0 to Teach Coding Agents Web Expertise
item.description:
Chrome has released Modern Web Guidance 1.0, a stable skill set that injects expert-reviewed web platform best practices and cross-browser compatibility data directly into coding agents. Version 1.0 adds a modernization workflow that scans existing codebases, an expanded guidance database, a public evaluation dashboard, and expands into a cross-browser initiative with Firefox and Edge.

item.title: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Adds a Direct Web Search API
item.description:
Amazon introduced a Web Search API for Bedrock AgentCore, letting developers retrieve ranked web results with text extracts, titles, URLs and publication times in a single API call instead of provisioning an AgentCore Gateway and MCP client. The lighter path targets code that only needs search results and is available in Oregon, Ireland, Tokyo and Sydney regions.

Why it matters：这是 AgentCore 检索能力的轻量化入口，降低了智能体接入实时网页信息的工程成本。

item.title: Open Source Stela Layer Runs Apple Silicon Code on x86-64 PCs
item.description:
Stela is a GPL-2.0 open source UEFI boot program that combines an arm64e-to-x86-64 AOT/JIT translator, a Metal driver for NVIDIA GPUs and a model of Apple Silicon hardware to boot macOS and most apps on ordinary x86-64 PCs. At v0.1.0 it is slow and limited in compatibility, with the project itself warning that boot success rates remain low and much hardware work is pending.

原文标题：开源项目 Stela 让 x86 PC 运行 Apple Silicon 程序

Why it matters：以开源方式在 x86 硬件上重建 Apple Silicon 运行环境，技术路径罕见且具讨论价值。

item.title: Stripe Closes $7.5B Acquisition of OpenRouter
item.description:
Stripe completed its acquisition of AI model aggregation platform OpenRouter on November 10, with the deal valued at roughly $7.5-8 billion. OpenRouter connects over 400 models from 80+ providers and serves more than 10 million developers, processing about 790 trillion tokens in October 2026, 76% of which came from agent-related API calls. The two will focus on token routing and usage optimization, folding model selection and billing into payment infrastructure.

原文标题：Stripe 以 75 亿美元完成收购 OpenRouter

Why it matters：AI 模型分发入口与支付基础设施的合并，直接改变开发者调用与计费模型的方式。

item.title: Nothing Teases First Screenless AI Device With Physical Button
item.description:
Nothing CEO Carl Pei unveiled the first look at the company's debut AI device on X, showing a screenless design with red and green LED indicators and a central physical button that likely serves as a push-to-talk interaction entry point. The product is expected to launch in December 2026, marking Nothing's first AI-native hardware after its $200 million Series C raised in 2025 to fund AI and OS development.

item.title: Nace AI Launches Drex Document Parser at $7 per 1,000 Pages
item.description:
Nace AI has launched Drex, a document parser that uses decision models to compare each OCR block against the original page image and sends only mismatches back for correction. It scores 0.834 on the Parse Index, beating GPT-6 Astra's 0.813, at $7 per 1,000 pages versus $70.57.

item.title: Google Gemini Rolls Out on Apple CarPlay with Hands-Free Voice Chat
item.description:
Google announced that its Gemini app is rolling out on Apple CarPlay worldwide for iOS users, covering all languages supported by Gemini Live. Drivers can hold hands-free voice conversations on the car screen, interrupt or switch topics at will, with chat history synced back to the iPhone app. Gemini can also tap Gmail and Google Calendar for daily briefings, email summaries and nearby destination queries.

Why it matters：Gemini 首次进入 CarPlay 车机场景，是 AI 助手向车载入口扩张的实质性一步。

item.title: Google Launches Gemini Decisions API for Batched Judgment Calls
item.description:
Google launched the Decisions API in Gemini API alongside the Gemini Decision 1 model, which skips text generation and returns structured yes/no, multiple-choice and scoring judgments with calibrated confidence for up to 1,000 questions per request. Pricing is $0.10 per million input tokens with no output charge, latency is 150-250 ms for inputs under 16K tokens, and Google claims it is nearly 5x cheaper than generating answers with Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite. The API turns routing, moderation and grading calls from generate-then-parse into direct calibrated probabilities usable as automation thresholds.

原文标题：Google 发布 Decisions API 单次可问 1000 个判断问题

Why it matters：把高频判断类调用从生成式解析改为结构化概率输出，定价与延迟数据明确，对 AI 应用架构有直接改造价值。

item.title: GitHub Actions 推出工作流锁文件防供应链攻击
item.description:
GitHub Actions 正式上线工作流锁文件功能，用于替代此前手动将 Action 固定到完整 SHA 的做法，以防范标签被篡改引发的供应链攻击。作者演示了通过 gh-actions-lock 扩展生成与维护锁文件的具体流程。该功能降低了 CI/CD 流水线的安全维护成本，对依赖 GitHub Actions 的开发者具有直接可用价值。

Why it matters：GitHub Actions 官方安全机制更新，附可复现的实操流程，对 CI/CD 安全实践有直接参考价值。

item.title: 谷歌发布 Gemini Decision 1 决策模型支持多模态
item.description:
谷歌推出 Gemini Decision 1，正式进入决策模型赛道，与 Jev、OpenAI 形成三足鼎立。该模型 API 支持是/否、多选与评分三类问题，且是三者中唯一覆盖文本、图像、音频、视频与 PDF 的全模态方案。定价为每百万输入 token 10 美分、输出免费，与 GPT-6 Luna 持平，但仍高于 Jev 的 4.2 美分。

item.title: 微软 1170 亿美元算力扩建采用表后自备电厂供电
item.description:
微软将每年 1170 亿美元的算力产能扩建与一项承诺绑定：新增电力成本不由纳税人或其他公用事业用户承担。其解决方案是表后自备发电，由雪佛龙建设 2.67GW 燃气电厂，向微软数据中心直供电力，合同期 20 年。该模式仍需政治审批，得州州长 Abbott 的数据中心许可冻结令及继任者的更强硬立场构成关键变量。

Why it matters：主流航司首次明确封禁 AI 智能体代订，直接触及智能体商业化的合规与信任红线。
